objects.name: Rainbow
objects.lore: Melchior a réuni la lumière du soleil et les couleurs d'une coquille venue d'un autre âge. Crono lève la lame et y retrouve les visages de ceux qui ont rendu cette rencontre possible. Même le temps ne se traverse pas seul.
objects.flavour: Toutes les couleurs d’un avenir possible.
objects.subject: Rainbow, Crono's legendary Chrono Trigger katana: a long slim single-edged polished silver blade with a very slight authentic katana curve, delicate rainbow iridescence along the hamon, small round antique-gold tsuba, burgundy diamond-wrapped straight grip and restrained brass pommel. Entire weapon shown diagonally with practical coherent geometry, not a wavy blade.
objects.scene: The katana rests diagonally on Melchior's worn timber forge bench near a quiet sunlit window; one small subtle nacre shell fragment nearby, warm sunlight splitting gently along the blade, calm workshop depth with no clutter.
objects.ring: aged gold tsuba-like circular metal with six restrained pearlescent rainbow enamel inserts, finely hammered metal, no spikes

objects.name: Arc Valkyrie
objects.lore: Marle a quitté les salles où l'on décidait de sa vie à voix basse. Dans sa main, l'arc ne porte aucun ordre royal. Elle tend la corde pour ceux qu'elle a choisis, et sa volonté ne tremble plus.
objects.flavour: Choisir sa route, puis tenir sa ligne.
objects.subject: Valkyrie Bow, Marle's legendary Chrono Trigger longbow, elegant full-length ivory pale ash wood limbs with restrained antique-gold wing-shaped reinforcement at the grip, quiet ice-blue small inlays, fine dark taut bowstring connecting both tips. An actual usable longbow, not crossbow; symmetric smooth natural bow curve, no warped shaft, no floating strings. One complete bow only, diagonal, no arrow.
objects.scene: The bow leans diagonally against a low pale stone window ledge in Guardia castle, early cold sunlight across ivory wood, one folded cream cloth at the grip, a quiet garden beyond. Empty scene with no characters, understated background.
objects.ring: pale brushed silver and ivory ashwood with small symmetrical gold feather engravings and four ice-blue enamel insets

objects.name: Wondershot
objects.lore: Lucca a passé la nuit à régler le mécanisme nourri par la Pierre du Soleil. Le cuivre garde la chaleur de ses doigts. Elle ne cherche pas seulement à construire une arme : elle veut prouver qu'une invention peut encore offrir un lendemain.
objects.flavour: Un peu de soleil dans la mécanique.
objects.subject: Wondershot, Lucca's Chrono Trigger Sun Stone powered science-fantasy gun: compact long-barrel ray pistol with perfectly straight cylindrical blued-steel barrel, substantial patinated brass receiver, one small warm amber glass energy chamber above trigger, reddish walnut grip with coherent hand trigger guard. Handmade ingenious retro technology, not modern tactical rifle, no extra barrels, no text or insignia. Whole silhouette in clean three-quarter side view.
objects.scene: The ray pistol lies on Lucca's scratched wooden workbench beside a folded blue cloth, a single warm amber reflection in the gun's chamber, quiet pale window light and understated empty workshop background. No other tools or weapons.
objects.ring: patinated brass concentric mechanical assembly with small blackened steel screws and warm amber glass inserts, restrained solar gleam

objects.name: Masamune
objects.lore: Frog a longtemps porté cette lame comme on porte une faute. Le souvenir de Cyrus n'exige pourtant pas qu'il reste prisonnier du passé. Quand il referme la main sur la garde, Glenn choisit enfin ce qu'il lui reste à protéger.
objects.flavour: Le courage survit au nom du héros.
objects.subject: Masamune from Chrono Trigger, Frog's legendary sword: long perfectly straight symmetric double-edged silver blade tapering to a centered point, clean central fuller, ornate compact golden crossguard, dark red leather straight grip, rounded golden pommel. Noble simple readable heroic longsword, authentic classic Masamune identity, no katana, no saw teeth, no curved blade. Entire weapon diagonally, coherent single axis.
objects.scene: Masamune rests diagonally on a broad moss-touched stone beside Cyrus's quiet memorial, pale dawn catching the blade, subdued forest beyond and one fold of a dark green cloak. No engraved readable text, no character, no other weapons.
objects.ring: worn gold crossguard motifs integrated into a circular brushed silver rim, subtle moss-green enamel details and two small paired symmetric gold joints

objects.name: Bras Tératon
objects.lore: Le métal de ce bras garde les marques d'un futur sans voix. Robo en règle chaque articulation avec patience. La même main peut briser un obstacle ou abriter une pousse : sa force tient désormais au choix qu'il fait.
objects.flavour: La force apprend aussi à prendre soin.
objects.subject: Teraton Arm, Robo's Chrono Trigger heavy mechanical punching forearm: one detached compact gold-ochre brass arm module with a clenched articulated five-finger metal fist, broad rounded plated forearm, exposed blackened-steel wrist joint, small cyan light and copper rivets. Chunky worn retro robot engineering matching Robo, no human flesh, no entire robot, no extra fingers, no spikes, practical heroic machine not modern sci-fi gun. Whole single forearm with intact silhouette in three-quarter view.
objects.scene: The arm module rests securely on a low ochre industrial maintenance bench in an abandoned dome, warm daylight through a broken high window, one tiny green shoot at the base of the bench, restrained architecture with real depth and no clutter. No other robot parts.
objects.ring: ochre brass segmented bearing ring with dark steel inset gears and three small pale cyan indicator lights, worn rounded Robo-like engineering

objects.name: Faux du Désespoir
objects.lore: Magus ne dit jamais ce qu'il cherche au-delà du prochain passage. Sa faux trace dans l'air une ligne froide, puis le silence revient. Sous le titre et la colère, un enfant continue de chercher sa sœur.
objects.flavour: Derrière la colère, un nom demeure.
objects.subject: Doom Scythe, Magus's Chrono Trigger legendary scythe: very long perfectly straight dark steel staff with plum leather grip, one large sweeping crescent-shaped silver cutting blade extending sideways from its top, understated dark gold collar, cold restrained violet reflection along inside edge. Clearly a full war scythe, not a small sickle. Whole shaft completely straight and entire curved blade visible with margin; diagonal placement fitted by zooming out, never bend shaft to fit.
objects.scene: The scythe rests diagonally across a low dark stone plinth in a silent castle chamber, pale moonlight on its silver blade, a single fold of deep violet cloth, softly painted distant arched opening and calm shadows. Empty scene, no skulls or extra weapons.
objects.ring: blackened silver circular rim with a clean inner crescent bevel, restrained violet enamel and small old-gold clamps, no protruding spikes
